summary: Russian forces reported destroying Ukrainian infrastructure targets and shooting down 797 drones and 2 long-range missiles in 24 hours. Ukrainian attacks on Russian territory caused seven casualties in Belgorod region, including a 16-year-old. NATO summit tensions emerged as Zelensky's participation was reportedly avoided to prevent conflicts with Trump.
key_points: Russian military reported destroying Ukrainian port infrastructure, energy facilities, and logistics centers in 24 hours. (Source: @tass_agency/384138)
Ukrainian attacks on Russian infrastructure increased, with seven casualties reported in Belgorod region from a bus attack. (Source: @tass_agency/384111)
Zelensky will not deliver a speech at the Ankara NATO summit to avoid angering Trump. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31421)
Poland reduced military aid to Ukraine by a factor of 15 compared to 2022-2023, with transfers not exceeding $1.55 billion. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31431)
Over 430 drones flew toward the Moscow region overnight, with 36 destroyed on approach. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31438)
Russian forces advanced toward Dobropolye from Novy Donbass, potentially planning counterattacks. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31438)
Ukrainian drone attacks damaged a Nova Poshta terminal in Krivoy Rog and burned 45 hectares of fields in Priazovsky district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31438)
NATO leaders downplayed Ukraine issues at the upcoming summit, fearing Trump's reaction. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31418)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces demonstrated sustained offensive capability, destroying critical Ukrainian infrastructure and neutralizing over 790 drones in 24 hours. Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian territory increased, causing casualties and infrastructure damage. NATO summit tensions emerged as Zelensky's participation was reportedly avoided to prevent conflicts with Trump. Polish military aid to Ukraine was significantly reduced, potentially impacting Ukrainian defense capabilities. Russian forces advanced toward Dobropolye, indicating possible counterattack plans.
sections.regional_response: NATO leaders downplayed Ukraine issues at the upcoming summit, fearing Trump's reaction. Polish military aid to Ukraine was reduced by a factor of 15, with transfers not exceeding $1.55 billion. The Polish Presidential Chancellery head was added to the Myrotvorets database, declaring continued opposition to Ukrainian 'Banderaism.' European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen promised new funding for Ukrainian drone production following Russian airstrikes on Ukrainian facilities. Slovakian temporarily stopped issuing Schengen visas to Russian tourists.
